array.string: cd "__PROJECT_DIR__" || exit 1; set -a; source .env || exit 1; set +a; /usr/bin/python3 fetch_papers.py --days 1 --max-ai 50 >> daily.log 2>&1 & PAPERS_PID=$!; /usr/bin/python3 fetch_news.py --days 1 --top 40 >> daily.log 2>&1 & NEWS_PID=$!; wait "$PAPERS_PID"; PAPERS_STATUS=$?; wait "$NEWS_PID"; NEWS_STATUS=$?; [ "$PAPERS_STATUS" -eq 0 ] && [ "$NEWS_STATUS" -eq 0 ]
